name: shadow

commands.command:
find man -name Makefile.in -exec sed -i 's/getspnam\.3 / /' {{}} \;
find man -name Makefile.in -exec sed -i 's/passwd\.5 / /'   {{}} \;

make exec_prefix=/usr install
make -C man install-man

description: The Shadow package contains programs for handling passwords in a secure way.

installed_descriptions.name: chage
installed_descriptions.description: Used to change the maximum number of days between obligatory password changes

installed_descriptions.name: chfn
installed_descriptions.description: Used to change a user's full name and other information

installed_descriptions.name: chgpasswd
installed_descriptions.description: Used to update group passwords in batch mode

installed_descriptions.name: chpasswd
installed_descriptions.description: Used to update user passwords in batch mode

installed_descriptions.name: chsh
installed_descriptions.description: Used to change a user's default login shell

installed_descriptions.name: faillog
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to examine the log of login failures, to set a maximum number of failures before an account is blocked, and to reset the failure count

installed_descriptions.name: getsubids
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to list the subordinate id ranges for a user

installed_descriptions.name: gpasswd
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to add and delete members and administrators to groups

installed_descriptions.name: groupadd
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a group with the given name

installed_descriptions.name: groupdel
installed_descriptions.description: Deletes the group with the given name

installed_descriptions.name: groupmod
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to modify the given group's name or GID

installed_descriptions.name: grpck
installed_descriptions.description: Verifies the integrity of the group files /etc/group and /etc/gshadow

installed_descriptions.name: grpconv
installed_descriptions.description: Creates or updates the shadow group file from the normal group file

installed_descriptions.name: grpunconv
installed_descriptions.description: Updates /etc/group from /etc/gshadow and then deletes the latter

installed_descriptions.name: login
installed_descriptions.description: Is used by the system to let users sign on

installed_descriptions.name: newgidmap
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to set the gid mapping of a user namespace

installed_descriptions.name: newgrp
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to change the current GID during a login session

installed_descriptions.name: newuidmap
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to set the uid mapping of a user namespace

installed_descriptions.name: newusers
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to create or update an entire series of user accounts

installed_descriptions.name: nologin
installed_descriptions.description: Displays a message saying an account is not available; it is designed to be used as the default shell for disabled accounts

installed_descriptions.name: passwd
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to change the password for a user or group account

installed_descriptions.name: pwck
installed_descriptions.description: Verifies the integrity of the password files /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow

installed_descriptions.name: pwconv
installed_descriptions.description: Creates or updates the shadow password file from the normal password file

installed_descriptions.name: pwunconv
installed_descriptions.description: Updates /etc/passwd from /etc/shadow and then deletes the latter

installed_descriptions.name: sg
installed_descriptions.description: Executes a given command while the user's GID is set to that of the given group

installed_descriptions.name: su
installed_descriptions.description: Runs a shell with substitute user and group IDs

installed_descriptions.name: useradd
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a new user with the given name, or updates the default new-user information

installed_descriptions.name: userdel
installed_descriptions.description: Deletes the specified user account

installed_descriptions.name: usermod
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to modify the given user's login name, user identification (UID), shell, initial group, home directory, etc.

installed_descriptions.name: vigr
installed_descriptions.description: Edits the /etc/group or /etc/gshadow files

installed_descriptions.name: vipw
installed_descriptions.description: Edits the /etc/passwd or /etc/shadow files

installed_descriptions.name: libsubid
installed_descriptions.description: library to handle subordinate id ranges for users and groups
